name: Jimmy Butler III
note: ESPN lists him out with a Jan 2, 2027 placeholder and says a December debut is too optimistic; Anthony Slater's September report projected January or February. CBS lists him out until at least Jan 2. Games estimate assumes a late-January return.

name: Mark Williams
injury: Torn left labrum, shoulder surgery Sept 10, 2026
expected_return: unknown (ESPN and CBS placeholder is Feb 3, 2027)
note: Shams Charania reported the surgery and an extended absence with no team timeline. Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach are competing for the starting center job.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
note: CBS updated Oct 17: out until at least Apr 2.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
expected_return: roughly late February to early March 2027
note: Shams Charania reported a six-month absence; ESPN and CBS both list him out until at least March 2.

name: Moses Moody
expected_return: unknown (ESPN and CBS placeholder is Dec 1, 2026)
note: He has progressed only to light on-court work. FantasySP expects him to miss the first half of the season, so the December placeholder may be optimistic.

name: Brandon Ingram
expected_return: unknown; ESPN and CBS placeholder moved to Nov 8, 2026 (was Nov 1)
note: Still no team timetable. CBS updated him Oct 15 to 'expected out until at least Nov 8', a week later than the prior placeholder. RotoWire (Oct 13) lists him as one of the biggest Yahoo ADP fallers (69.2 to 75.9).

name: Kristaps Porzingis
expected_return: unknown; ESPN and CBS placeholder is Nov 9, 2026
note: Warriors say he remains out indefinitely, is back at the practice facility and around the team, but not cleared to practice; he missed the Hawaii trip and the first five preseason games. ESPN's Oct 15 note set a Nov 9 placeholder (was 'unknown' in the Oct 12 entry). Draymond Green penciled in as starting center. The placeholder is not a team timeline, so the miss could run longer.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
injury: Partial plantar plate tear, second toe, right foot
note: Chris Haynes reported at least four weeks from Oct 7. ESPN warns foot injuries for big men often run past the first window.

name: Max Strus
injury: Partially torn plantar fascia, right foot
expected_return: ESPN and CBS placeholder is Nov 8, 2026
note: CBS updated Oct 15 to out until at least Nov 8; the prior entry had a re-evaluation about Nov 2. No new team statement found.

name: Isaiah Stewart
note: CBS (Oct 15): expected out until at least Oct 23.

name: Maxime Raynaud
injury: Right patellar subluxation (partial kneecap dislocation), no serious ligament damage
expected_return: early November 2026; ESPN and CBS placeholder is Nov 2, 2026
note: KHTK's Frankie Cartoscelli reported Oct 15 he is expected to miss at least the first five or six regular-season games, possibly longer. Prior entry only had a re-evaluation around Oct 25. Backup C Dylan Cardwell (calf) is also out to about Nov 2, so Sabonis carries the frontcourt.

name: Kyle Filipowski
injury: Offseason back surgery for a herniated disc
note: Will Hardy said on Oct 10 there is no return timeline. Games estimate is a guess.

name: Dereck Lively II
note: Ruled out of the Oct 16 exhibition with a foot issue; CBS lists him as a game-time decision. He has a foot history.

name: Bradley Beal
injury: Right knee inflammation (separate from the left hip surgery he has recovered from)
expected_return: unknown; ESPN and CBS placeholder is Nov 8, 2026
note: Tyronn Lue said Oct 14 that Beal will not be ready for the regular-season start, rehab is going 'pretty well' but there is no timetable. ESPN and CBS both moved him to an Nov 8 placeholder on Oct 14-15. Garland, Wagler and Dunn absorb backcourt minutes meanwhile. Games estimate counts LAC games from Oct 21 to Nov 8.

name: Kon Knueppel
expected_return: Re-evaluation the week of Oct 19; very likely to miss the start of the season
note: Missed all of preseason. ESPN still lists him day-to-day as of Oct 18; no team update since early October, when Charles Lee said he was pain-free and progressing toward contact. GM Jeff Peterson did not know whether he plays the Oct 21 opener.

name: Coby White
note: Missed the whole preseason; no practice update since Oct 5. He strained both calves last season.

name: Nic Claxton
expected_return: Likely misses Oct 21 opener at TOR
note: Chicago Sun-Times (Oct 16): ramping up in practice but not fully cleared and likely to miss the opener; Jalen Smith expected to start.

name: Tobias Harris
note: Mitch Johnson called him totally questionable for the opener and said the Spurs will not rush him.

name: Chet Holmgren
expected_return: Game-time decision for opener Oct 20 vs SAS
note: No preseason games. Ruled out of the Oct 15 game vs HOU; ESPN lists him day-to-day with a projected Oct 20 return. On Oct 17 Daigneault deferred to the injury report, due 5pm the day before the opener. Severity undisclosed; described as precautionary.

name: Isaiah Hartenstein
injury: Ankle (kept him out of Germany's summer games)
note: He is absent from both the ESPN and CBS injury pages as of Oct 15-16, while OKC's other injured players (Holmgren, Wallace, Jaylin Williams, Sorber, Topic) are all listed for the Oct 15 finale. One search summary said he played in that game (6 pts, 8 reb), but I could not confirm that line from a box score or a dated article. Treat it as likely available, unverified.

name: Collin Sexton
note: JJ Redick called him day to day; ESPN says the Lakers may hold him out until the opener.

name: Anthony Black
note: Full practice participant on Oct 9 but has not made a preseason debut. Last season's second half was derailed by back, abdominal and quad injuries.

name: Anfernee Simons
note: Out for the Oct 15 preseason game with a hamstring issue; listed GTD.

name: Mikel Brown Jr.
note: The No. 6 pick has not played in the preseason; his last chance is Oct 14.

name: Grayson Allen
note: Missed the Oct 11 exhibition. He played 51 games last season.

name: Joel Embiid
injury: Chronic left knee; announced workload management
note: Nick Nurse said on Sept 29 that Embiid's workload will be closely managed and that the team is already planning his and LeBron's back-to-backs (PhillyVoice via RotoWire, also reported by RotoBaller). He played 38 games last season and 57 of 164 over two. Games estimate covers planned rest only.

name: LeBron James
injury: Chronic left foot arthritis and lower-back management, age 41
note: Dave McMenamin (ESPN) reported on Oct 5 that the foot arthritis gets daily treatment and Philadelphia has discussed managing his workload and back-to-backs. He played 60 games last season after missing the first month with sciatica.

name: Kawhi Leonard
injury: No current injury; phased ramp-up and a team load management plan
note: Darko Rajakovic said Toronto has a load management plan for him. He did no live play all summer, had his first full practice Oct 5 and was due to debut Oct 13 (TSN, NBC Sports player news). He has not reached 70 games since 2017.

name: Stephen Curry
injury: Right knee patellofemoral pain syndrome with a bone bruise last season, age 38
note: He played 43 games last season. ESPN's outlook cites concerns about the knee's long-term health, and Monte Poole (NBC Sports Bay Area) said it needs active management. He was held to about 20 minutes and skipped the second night of a preseason back-to-back.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
injury: Returning from a torn right Achilles (June 2025); right ankle tweak Oct 7 resolved
note: Played Oct 13 at OKC: 24 points (9-14 FG, 4-6 3PT), 5 reb, 3 ast, 2 blk in 18 minutes, so the ankle tweak is behind him. Rick Carlisle's workload-monitoring comment still stands; no formal rest plan announced, so the games estimate is a guess.

name: Kyrie Irving
injury: Returning from a torn left ACL (March 3, 2025); Grade 2 calf strain in December 2025 delayed rehab
note: He missed all of 2025-26 and played 22 minutes in his first game back on Oct 11 (ESPN, TSN). NBC Sports says he is on a preseason minutes restriction and has not topped 60 games since 2018-19. No regular-season rest plan has been announced, so the games estimate is mine.

name: Damian Lillard
injury: Returning from a torn left Achilles (2025), age 36
note: He missed all of 2025-26, played 19 minutes on Oct 7 and took a maintenance day Oct 12. Lillard says he has no restrictions; NBC Sports lists him as a full go. No rest plan is announced, so the games estimate is mine.

name: Fred VanVleet
injury: Returning from a torn right ACL (September 2025)
note: He missed all of 2025-26. Ime Udoka said his minutes limit depends on camp, and RotoWire expects him to be limited all season and held out of some back-to-backs. NBC Sports also flags an opening minutes restriction.

name: Zach Edey
injury: Left elbow and ankle surgeries in March 2026
note: Minutes ramped through preseason, ending with 10 points and 6 rebounds in 21 minutes Oct 16. Says the ankle feels great; conditioning still a work in progress.

name: Alex Sarr
injury: Right foot fracture repaired in mid-June 2026
note: He made his preseason debut Oct 10 and RotoWire expects a heavy minutes restriction early. He played 48 games last season.

name: Anthony Davis
injury: No current injury; playing on a preseason minutes limit after a 20-game season
note: Last season ended with left hand ligament damage plus calf and groin injuries, and he never played for Washington after the trade. ESPN notes more than 60 games only once in four seasons; RotoWire, ESPN and FantasyPros all call him a bust at ADP. Games estimate assumes rest on some back-to-backs.

name: Al Horford
note: He played 45 games last season and is already getting preseason rest days. He may start while Porzingis is out.

name: Zion Williamson
injury: No current injury; long history of lower-body injuries
note: He played 62 games last season and 30 the year before, the second-most of his career. ESPN's Steve Alexander does not trust him past 50 games, and Athlon lists him as a bust.

name: LaMelo Ball
injury: No current injury; recurring ankle problems
note: He played 72 games last season, one of only two seasons in his career above 51. Healthy through three preseason games with Minnesota.

name: Lauri Markkanen
injury: Minor neck soreness in preseason; late-season shutdowns in prior years
note: He played a career-low 42 games last season as Utah tanked. He missed one exhibition with neck soreness and was off the injury report by Oct 12. NBC Sports thinks a playoff push lowers the shutdown risk.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injury: Left knee surgery in 2026 to remove a growth
note: He played 48 games last season and three for Utah. He has topped 70 games twice in eight seasons but looked healthy in two preseason games.

name: Franz Wagner
note: Left the Oct 16 preseason finale vs MIA with right shoulder soreness and did not return.

name: Michael Porter Jr.
injury: Minor wrist soreness in preseason; long back history
note: He played 52 games last season and has passed 62 only twice in seven years. He returned from the wrist issue on Oct 12.

name: Trey Murphy III
note: He played 66 games last season and has topped 66 only once in five years.

name: Darius Garland
injury: Toe injury limited him to 45 games last season
note: Healthy now per ESPN and NBC Sports, with a bigger role while Ingram is out. RotoWire warns the Clippers have little reason to push him late because they do not own their 2027 pick.

name: Dejounte Murray
note: Did not play the Oct 16 preseason finale (toe).

name: Ja Morant
injury: Ankle, calf and elbow injuries last season
note: He played 20 games last season and 79 over three. Portland is also considering bringing him off the bench behind Lillard and Holiday.

name: Paul George
injury: No current injury; long record of missed games
note: He played 37 games last season and has reached 70 once in seven seasons. Healthy in the preseason with Boston.

name: Jalen Suggs
injury: Illness for about a week in camp
note: He has had one healthy season in five and played 57 games last season. The illness is not expected to cost regular-season games but cut into his camp reps.

name: Ty Jerome
injury: Ankle and calf injuries last season
note: He played 15 games last season. He is healthy in the preseason and has the inside track to start at point guard.

name: Mitchell Robinson
injury: Undisclosed issue cost him one preseason game
note: He returned on Oct 10. RotoWire calls him one of the most injury-prone big men in the league and expects his workload to be monitored; he played 60 games last season.

name: Aaron Gordon
injury: No current injury; back-to-back injury-shortened seasons
note: He played 36 games last season and 87 over two. He has looked healthy in three preseason games.

name: Cameron Johnson
note: He has never played more than 66 games in a season and played 54 last year.

name: Jakob Poeltl
note: He played 46 games last season. Toronto says he is moving well, and he played 18 minutes in the Oct 3 exhibition.

name: Jayson Tatum
injury: Returned from a ruptured right Achilles (May 2025)
expected_return: Expected to play opener Oct 20 at DET
note: Rested for the Oct 16 finale; CBS reported Oct 17 he is expected to play the opener. Boston kept him on a minutes limit and off back-to-backs last season; no 2026-27 restriction found.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injury: Lower-leg injury limited him to 36 games in 2025-26
expected_return: Expected to play opener Oct 21 vs MIN
note: Rested for the Oct 16 finale after playing 3 of 4 preseason games, including 20 points, 15 rebounds and 9 assists in 24 minutes Oct 14. CBS says he is expected to play Wednesday.

name: Domantas Sabonis
injury: Undisclosed (missed 3 preseason games); torn left meniscus last season
note: Missed preseason games Oct 8, 10 and 13 with no reason given, then returned for the Oct 16 finale vs SAS: 14 points and 10 rebounds in 30 minutes.

name: Walker Kessler
note: Missed the first 3 preseason games with a jammed pinky, debuted Oct 13 (11 points, 9 rebounds) and played Oct 16. Shoulder reported as no issue.

name: Jalen Williams
injury: Four hamstring strains and a wrist issue last season
note: He played 33 games last season. ESPN, RotoWire and NBC Sports all report him healthy, and he has played in the preseason.

name: Trae Young
injury: Right quadriceps contusion and lower-back irritation ended his 2025-26 season
note: He played 15 games last season and five for Washington. He was cleared for camp on Oct 1.

name: Jalen Duren
expected_return: Expected for opener Oct 20 vs BOS
note: Preseason debut Oct 14 at MIN: 24 points on 8-of-9 shooting in 15 minutes. Conditioning clauses were removed from his 5-year, $200M deal. Not on any injury report.

name: De'Aaron Fox
note: Made his preseason debut Oct 14 vs. Phoenix, playing the first half (18:33, 9 pts, 4 ast). Mitch Johnson had called the hip tightness nothing serious. San Antonio debuted the Fox/Harper/Castle three-guard look that night, which Johnson called a natural evolution that will take time.

name: Brandon Miller
injury: Shin contusion in camp; shoulder surgery in May 2026
note: He returned Oct 11 with 18 points in 22 minutes. Only FantasyPros mentions the May shoulder surgery, so treat that detail as unconfirmed. He played 27 games two seasons ago.

name: Victor Wembanyama
note: ESPN notes he has missed 54 games over the last two seasons. His only preseason absence was scheduled rest.

name: Luka Doncic
note: ESPN notes he has missed 50 games over the last two seasons. He sat the second night of a preseason back-to-back and returned Oct 8.

name: Cade Cunningham
note: He has played more than 64 games once in his career and 64 last season. His preseason absence was rest.

name: Jalen Brunson
note: He announced a full clearance on Sept 24 and has played in the preseason without issue.

name: Josh Giddey
note: He played 54 games last season and was a full participant at camp with no restrictions.

name: Austin Reaves
note: He missed two exhibitions and returned Oct 8. He played 51 games last season.

name: James Harden
note: Missed the Oct 8 preseason game, returned Oct 11 with 24 points and played 27 minutes Oct 13. Not on the ESPN or CBS injury lists as of Oct 18.

name: Evan Mobley
note: He played 65 games last season and has been under 70 in three of five seasons.

name: Devin Booker
note: He played 64 games last season; RotoWire notes nagging injuries in recent years.

name: Tyler Herro
note: He played 33 games last season and is participating in camp with Milwaukee.

name: Ivica Zubac
note: He played 48 games last season, five for Indiana. RotoWire and NBC Sports both report him healthy.

name: Keyonte George
note: He played 54 games last season after Utah sat him for the final stretch. Healthy in the preseason.

name: Jarrett Allen
note: He matched a career low with 56 games last season after averaging 80 over the prior two.

name: Scottie Barnes
injury: Knee soreness after a bump on Oct 3
note: He practiced Oct 6 and TSN reports no concern.

name: Miles Bridges
note: He practiced Oct 9 and sat the Oct 10 exhibition; ESPN says he is trending in the right direction.

name: Jalen Green
note: He played 32 games last season and has played all three preseason games.

name: Zach LaVine
injury: Surgery in February 2026 for a torn tendon in his right fifth finger
note: He played 39 games last season. GM Scott Perry said he is healthy for camp; NBC Sports reports he is on the trade block.

name: Keegan Murray
injury: Left ankle surgery last season; undisclosed issue in camp
note: He played 23 games last season, missed two exhibitions and was cleared Oct 10.

name: Kevin Porter Jr.
injury: Arthroscopic right knee surgery in April 2026
note: He played 38 games last season and is participating in camp.

name: Jonathan Kuminga
note: Chris Finch called it bumps and bruises and said the team is being overly cautious. He played 36 games last season.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
note: He played 10 games last season and is a full participant in camp.

name: Day'Ron Sharpe
note: He missed one exhibition and returned Oct 12. RotoWire's centers piece also mentions a thumb injury.

name: Josh Hart
expected_return: Expected to play opener Oct 20 vs PHI
note: Sat the Oct 15 finale; Mike Brown does not expect it to affect his opener status.

name: Bam Adebayo
expected_return: Day-to-day; next chance is the Oct 21 opener vs MIN
note: Missed the Oct 14 and Oct 16 preseason games with right groin tightness. Spoelstra said he is not 'overly concerned'. No new diagnosis.

name: Aaron Nesmith
note: Sat out the Oct 15 preseason finale with a hamstring issue.

name: Santi Aldama
note: Out Oct 14 vs NOP while recovering from knee surgery; ESPN Oct 15 says unlikely for the Oct 16 finale vs ATL. No opener statement found. Games estimate is a guess.

name: Robert Williams III
note: RotoWire 'off injury report' Oct 13, available for that game vs SAC after a rest day. On Oct 8 vs GSW he had 8 pts, 5 reb, 5 blk in 14 min off the bench. RotoWire projects about 18 mpg backing up Clingan, with Yang Hansen a threat to those minutes. Still skips back-to-backs historically.

name: AJ Dybantsa
expected_return: Opener Oct 21 vs MIL in doubt but not ruled out
note: Rolled his left ankle Oct 16 at NOP and did not return; Keefe called it a sprain and the removal precautionary. No imaging results found.

name: Malik Monk
expected_return: Could miss the start of the season
note: ESPN (Oct 16): ankle injury, could miss the start of the season.

name: Jrue Holiday
note: Held out of the Oct 16 preseason finale with right hand soreness.
